introFirstTitle:
Can't remember about things you have to do?
Write it down, simple as that! 😎
introFirstText: Stay organized and never forget a task again. With our to-do app, you can quickly jot down your tasks, set priorities, and stay on top of your daily responsibilities—all in one place.
introSecondText: No need to keep everything in your head. Set reminders, get notified at the right time, and let us help you stay focused on what truly matters.
introThirdText: Free your mind from clutter. By keeping your tasks neatly organized, you’ll reduce stress and boost productivity—so you can enjoy life with peace of mind.
